response.sql: WITH rep_counts AS (SELECT e.EmployeeId, e.City, COUNT(*) AS customer_count FROM Employee AS e JOIN Customer AS c ON c.SupportRepId = e.EmployeeId GROUP BY e.EmployeeId, e.City), compared AS (SELECT City, customer_count, AVG(customer_count) OVER (PARTITION BY City) AS city_average, SUM(customer_count) OVER () AS total_matched_customers FROM rep_counts) SELECT City, SUM(customer_count) AS total_customers, AVG(customer_count - city_average) AS average_excess, AVG(CAST(customer_count AS REAL) / total_matched_customers) AS average_share FROM compared WHERE customer_count > city_average GROUP BY City;
